title: Telco Customer Churn Prediction
subtitle: Machine Learning Workflow & Streamlit App
description: An end-to-end Machine Learning project predicting customer churn risk using the Kaggle Telco Customer Churn dataset, featuring a FastAPI serving backend and an interactive Streamlit UI.
longDescription:
Developed as an end-to-end Machine Learning group project, this application predicts customer churn risk using the Telco Customer Churn dataset from Kaggle. The project covers the complete data science lifecycle—from exploratory data analysis and feature engineering to model training, evaluation, and production serving.

The system features a microservice architecture with a dedicated FastAPI backend for real-time model inference and an interactive Streamlit web dashboard where users can adjust customer variables and instantly calculate churn risk. It also includes a dedicated Python CLI tool for automated model training and pipeline inspection.
highlights: Full ML lifecycle including feature engineering, model training, and evaluation
Real-time inference backend microservice built with FastAPI and Uvicorn
Interactive Streamlit web frontend for live customer churn risk assessment
Dedicated Python CLI utility for automated model training and testing
Collaborative team project with Git version control and environment management

title: Oracle-LLM
subtitle: Conversational CSV Data Analysis with Local SmolLM2
description: A FastAPI-based REST API that enables users to upload CSV datasets and ask natural language questions using a local, offline Small Language Model (SmolLM2).
longDescription:
Oracle-LLM is an intelligent REST API built with FastAPI that brings natural language querying to tabular data using locally hosted Small Language Models. Users can upload any CSV dataset and ask analytical questions without sending sensitive data to third-party cloud providers.

The system implements a modular, sequential LLM processing chain. When a user asks a question, a DataSelector step extracts the most relevant rows and schema properties, which are then routed to an LLMRunner running Hugging Face's SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct model on local CPU. Subsequent AnalysisStep and ResponseParser phases refine and format the output into clean, reliable JSON responses.
highlights: Modular sequential processing chain (DataSelector, LLMRunner, AnalysisStep, ResponseParser)
Local offline CPU inference with Hugging Face SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct (~3.5 GB weights)
RESTful API built with FastAPI, Pydantic schemas, and interactive Swagger documentation (/docs)
In-memory dataset parsing and dynamic row filtering powered by Pandas

title: Words and Di(c)e
subtitle: Online PvP Word Game
description: A TDD-developed player-versus-player browser word game with real-time multiplayer synchronization and matchmaking.
longDescription: Words and Di(c)e (WnD) is a browser-based word game where players compete in real time to guess words fetched from an external API. The game utilizes test-driven development (TDD), short polling for game synchronization, and a custom invite system for smooth multiplayer sessions.
highlights: Test-Driven Development (TDD) approach with thorough test coverage
Automated CI/CD pipeline verifying test suites before deployment
Real-time state synchronization for active multiplayer gameplay
Unique GUID-based invite code system for player matchmaking

title: Filmvisarna
subtitle: Movie Theater Web Platform with Adaptive Theme UI
description: A cinema booking platform with an interactive seat reservation system and a dynamic UI that adapts its theme to the selected movie genre.
longDescription: Filmvisarna is a modern cinema booking platform featuring a genre-adaptive layout that dynamically shifts its theme and atmosphere based on the movie genre being browsed. The platform provides an engaging user experience with an interactive seat reservation system, an intuitive checkout flow, and an integrated AI assistant to guide moviegoers.
highlights: Dynamic genre-adaptive layout and visual theme
Interactive seat reservation and booking system
Cloud-based backend architecture optimized for real-time operations
Integrated AI assistant helping users discover movies

title: Pokémon TCG Store
subtitle: Web Store Built in React
description: We were provided with JSON datasets containing Pokémon cards, which I transformed into a full e-commerce store with search and shopping cart functionality.
longDescription: A fully functional web store built in React and TypeScript using Pokémon TCG card data. The project features dynamic card browsing, filtering by type and rarity, in-browser shopping cart management, and a responsive checkout simulation.
highlights: Dynamic catalog display with JSON card data and real-time search filtering
Shopping cart with automatic subtotal calculation and quantity adjustments
Structured component hierarchy with end-to-end TypeScript type safety

title: Holidaymaker
subtitle: Minimal API Agile Group Project
description: Minimal API developed during a 2-week sprint as a collaborative group project within our agile development course.
longDescription: A group project completed during a two-week agile sprint (Scrum). The project involved requirements gathering, data modeling, and developing a Minimal API in C# .NET to manage hotel bookings, room availability, and guest registrations.
highlights: Agile team collaboration with Scrum ceremonies, daily standups, and GitHub Projects
Minimal API architecture in .NET using Entity Framework Core and SQL
Clear separation of concerns between database and presentation layers

title: Restaurant SQL Database
subtitle: Relational MySQL Database
description: Relational database designed and implemented in MySQL as the examination project for our database design course.
longDescription: Final examination project in database design where a complete relational database was conceptualized (ER diagram), normalized to the third normal form (3NF), and implemented with relational tables, foreign keys, triggers, and views.
highlights: Comprehensive conceptual and logical entity-relationship diagram (ERD)
Full 3NF normalization to eliminate data redundancy
Complex SQL queries, joins, and stored procedures

title: Hotel State Manager
subtitle: Console Application Bonus Assignment
description: Allows an administrator to design and configure hotel floor layouts, which managers can subsequently operate and monitor.
longDescription: An architectural state and management console tool. The system enables administrators to define and configure hotel floor layouts and room tiers, while reception and hotel managers oversee occupancy in real time.
highlights: State management and dynamic matrix representation of hotel rooms
Role-based console interface in C# for administrators and hotel managers
Persistent data storage of hotel room configurations

title: Healthcare System
subtitle: OOP/C# Team Project
description: Console application simulating a comprehensive healthcare system with distinct permission levels for patients, medical staff, and administrators.
longDescription: A simulated healthcare and electronic medical records (EMR) system developed as an OOP group project. The application manages patient health records, appointment bookings, doctor notes, and secure access control governed by user roles.
highlights: Role-based access management (Patient, Doctor, Administrator)
Object-oriented modeling of electronic health records and appointment scheduling
Team development using code reviews and a structured Git branching strategy

title: Trading System
subtitle: Item Trading Assignment
description: Interactive item trading system allowing multiple users to exchange virtual inventory items securely.
longDescription: An item exchange and trading system built in C# that simulates secure inventory swaps between users with offer validation and state confirmation.
highlights: Inventory and item management governed by strict business rules
Two-way trade confirmation to prevent transaction errors
Modular structure enabling straightforward extension of item categories

title: School Management System
subtitle: Simulated Educational Platform
description: Console application allowing students to track grades, teachers to manage courses and schedules, and administrators to oversee the institution.
longDescription: A complete school management system in C# bringing together students, teachers, and administrators. The application handles course enrollments, grading, attendance tracking, and scheduling within a cohesive architecture.
highlights: End-to-end workflow from course enrollment to grade reporting
Clean data modeling of academic entities (Student - Course - Grade)
Robust console UI with secured operations per authorization level
